load_perplexity_measurement: load the perplexity measurement module from the Hugging Face evaluate library
run_gradio_widget: run a gradio widget for the perplexity measurement module
compute_perplexity: compute perplexity scores for a given text dataset using the loaded measurement module
list_evaluation_modules: list available evaluation modules in the Hugging Face evaluate library
combine_evaluations: combine multiple evaluation modules into a single combined evaluation
